youtube.title: What a Heat Pump Really Costs to Install, and What Help Is Left
youtube.description:
Commonwealth of Reason: Commission on Spending
An inquiry into what things actually cost.

What does a heat pump really cost to install, compared with the system you would buy anyway?

Commission on Spending: https://commonwealthofreason.com/commissions/spending/
The full record on heat pumps, claim by claim: https://commonwealthofreason.com/heat-pumps/
The evidence and the full answer: https://commonwealthofreason.com/heat-pumps/does-the-upfront-cost-eat-the-savings/

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:20 What does a heat pump really cost compared with what you would buy anyway?
3:46 What heat pump tax credits and rebates are left in 2026?
6:09 Close

Studies cited
- Bernard 2024 (NBER), UK heat pumps and a time-of-use tariff
- Canadian Climate Institute 2023, heat pumps pay off
- CEE 2017, cold-climate heat pumps in Minnesota
- Deetjen 2021, private economics of US residential heat pumps
- DOE 2026, Program Notice 26-2 on electric home rebates
- Edwards 2024, inequities in heat pump bill savings
- IRS 2025, end of the 25C and 25D credits
- IRS, the 25C home improvement credit
- Less 2021 (LBNL), cost of decarbonization retrofits
- Mass Save 2026, air-source heat pump rebates
- North Carolina 2026, Energy Saver program changes
- National Housing Trust 2026, state rebate tracker
- PNNL 2025, DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge field results
- RMI 2018, the economics of electrifying buildings
- Wilson 2024 (NREL and LBNL), heat pumps for all?

Commonwealth of Reason. The Commonwealth is fictional. The research is real.

Music: Undertow, an original composition made with strudel-bench (https://github.com/jonborchardt/strudel-bench), 84 bpm D:minor.
